subject: Sponsor tiers & onboarding grant — term details and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@launchpad.st>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Benji Torres <benji@founderslab.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor tiers & onboarding grant — initial proposal

Hi Aditya,

Great to meet you on Tuesday — excited about the Demo Day collaboration. We pulled together an initial sponsor tiering doc and a short onboarding grant proposal for startups accepted into FoundersLab. Attached are: sponsor_tiers_v1.pdf and onboarding_grant_matrix.xlsx.

High level: we typically give accepted startups a $2k–$10k cloud credit depending on tier, plus co-marketing and workshop slots. FoundersLab is asking whether Redwood can match a program-level onboarding grant (starter credits + ramp support) and a 25% sponsor discount for names in Tier A.

Questions for you:
- Is Redwood able to provide a standardized onboarding credit for all cohort participants (pilot-sized, ~25 companies) or does that need to be negotiated per startup?
- For Tier A sponsors, is a 25% discount on our public pricing something your finance team can approve for a channel partner package, or would you prefer a usage-credit top-up instead?
- Any constraints on public mentions or marketing co-branding we should know about?

We are trying to finalize sponsor collateral by next Friday (8/13). Could we aim for a short sync Thursday to go over constraints and draft the sponsor line items?

Thanks —
Elena Park
Partnerships Lead, LaunchPad Ventures
elena@launchpad.st

P.S. Benji looped in Dana from legal to help on a quick T&Cs check — she’s on copy.

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Park <elena@launchpad.st>
Cc: Benji Torres <benji@founderslab.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor tiers & onboarding grant — initial proposal

Elena — thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick answers up top, then I’ll hand to Marissa and Ben for pricing mechanics and legal specifics.

Short answers:
- We can provide a standardized cohort onboarding grant (preferred) rather than per-startup negotiation. That simplifies ops and improves turnaround.
- A 25% sponsor discount is doable for Tier A, but we usually structure that as either: a) a sponsor-facing discount on invoiceable items (requires a formal sponsor agreement) or b) sponsor-funded credit top-ups for participant accounts (cleaner from us because we manage invoicing through the cohort). Option (b) is what we recommend — sponsor pays for a bulk top-up that we allocate.
- Marketing co-branding is fine; we’ll need to review embargo language and logo usage but have no blanket prohibition.

Marissa — can you confirm the smallest standard onboarding package we can offer for a cohort (e.g., $3k RPU equivalent per startup for 25 companies = $75k committed grant) and whether we can offer a 25% Tier A discount alternative as a partner SKU?
Ben — will need a quick read on the sponsor invoice flow (credit top-up vs discount) and whether we can define a sponsor-level SLA or entitlement.

Happy to meet Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT if that works; I’ll pencil it in and send a calendar invite.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment references: sponsor_tiers_v1.pdf, onboarding_grant_matrix.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, Elena Park <elena@launchpad.st>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, Benji Torres <benji@founderslab.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor tiers & onboarding grant — initial proposal

Aditya / Elena — looping in specifics from pricing and program ops. Below is a recommended structure that balances our cost exposure and FoundersLab's asks.

Proposal (recommended):
- Cohort onboarding grant (standard): $2,500 RPU credit per accepted startup, applied as an account top-up on activation. For 25 companies = $62,500.
- Sponsor-funded top-up for Tier A (instead of 25% blanket discount): Redwood invoices FoundersLab for a bulk top-up pool (e.g., $40k) and we allocate $1.6k per Tier A company from that pool. This keeps our billing clean and prevents discount layering across other promos.
- For optics, we will include a "Sponsor Partner SKU" on the invoice and provide a co-branded usage report monthly.

Legal/terms notes (Dana):
- We’ll need a short sponsor addendum: payment terms, usage expiration (12 months), and a clause preventing double-dipping with other Redwood promos.
- We can accept a single bulk payment or a 50/50 split (50% upfront, 50% on first allocation).

Open questions:
1) Does FoundersLab prefer the onboarding grant to be $2.5k or $3k? (3k increases Redwood exposure but is more attractive)
2) Do you want an invoice-based discount (25%) instead? If so, finance will need to treat sponsors as resellers for accounting.

Elena — if you confirm preferred grant size and payment timing, Ben and I will draft the sponsor addendum and a one-page partner summary you can include in the sponsor deck.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Partnerships Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: onboarding_grant_matrix.xlsx (revised suggestions embedded)

From: Benji Torres <benji@founderslab.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Park <elena@launchpad.st>, Dana Collins <dana.collins@founderslab.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 11:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor tiers & onboarding grant — initial proposal

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- FoundersLab prefers the $3k onboarding grant if Redwood can support it, but we understand exposure concerns. Would Redwood consider a $3k grant if FoundersLab commits to a visibility package (booth + keynote mention) for Tier A sponsors?
- For payment timing, we usually collect sponsor funds upfront and can pay the bulk top-up 100% on invoice — that’s our preference to speed allocation.
- On the legal side, Dana says a one-page addendum and a clear non-double-dip clause will be fine.

If Redwood can accept 100% upfront on the bulk top-up and commit to a $3k grant only for Tier A participants (Tier B remains $2.5k), we should be able to finalize sponsor collateral by Friday.

Quick ask: can you send a draft one-pager (partner summary) by EOD so I can slot it into the deck?

—Benji

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Benji Torres <benji@founderslab.com>, Elena Park <elena@launchpad.st>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, Dana Collins <dana.collins@founderslab.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor tiers & onboarding grant — initial proposal (next steps)

Benji / Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short summary and next steps: 

Summary:
- Redwood will offer a cohort onboarding grant. We can do: Tier A = $3,000 per accepted startup; Tier B = $2,500 per accepted startup.
- Sponsor-funded bulk top-up accepted; Redwood will invoice FoundersLab for the sponsor pool. We accept 100% upfront payment.
- We’ll provide a co-branded monthly usage report and include a Sponsor Partner SKU on the invoice.
- Legal addendum: one page, usage expires after 12 months, non-double-dip clause.

Next steps (action owners):
- Marissa: Draft one-pager partner summary + sponsor addendum (target: EOD Friday 8/6).
- Ben/Elena: Confirm sponsor funds amount and payment method so we can issue the invoice (target: Mon 8/9).
- Ben: Please confirm whether Tier A will get keynote mention as discussed; that will lock the $3k grant.
- Aditya/Ben: If confirmed, I’ll route for approvals and generate the DocuSign sponsor addendum.

We’ve attached the revised sponsor_tiers_v1.pdf and onboarding_grant_matrix.xlsx for your reference. I’ll also drop the one-pager into the Drive link and send a DocuSign invite once Ben confirms.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to wrapping this up.

—Aditya
